summary: The AI model repository and deployment platform ecosystem in 2026 is highly concentrated, with Hugging Face dominating open-source model hosting with over 2 million models and the top 0.01% of models accounting for nearly half of all downloads. A diverse set of complementary platforms has emerged to serve different needs, ranging from serverless GPU inference and pay-per-use APIs to enterprise-grade private deployment, with key players including Ollama for local inference, Replicate and Together AI for cloud inference, Fireworks AI for speed-optimized serving, and AWS Bedrock for enterprise integration. DeepSeek has surpassed Mistral in cumulative Hugging Face downloads as of January 2026, while Llama remains the most downloaded model family with 476 million cumulative downloads recorded by March 2026.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The leading open-source AI model repository and collaboration platform, hosting models, datasets, and demo applications (Spaces) for the global ML community.
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public repositories; Pro plan at $9/month; Enterprise Hub from $20/user/month; Inference Endpoints billed per compute hour based on hardware selected.
features: Hosts over 2 million models across text, vision, audio, and multimodal tasks
Model versioning, dataset hosting, and model cards for documentation
Spaces for hosting live ML demos and apps using Gradio or Streamlit
Inference API for quick serverless model testing
Inference Endpoints for dedicated, scalable production deployment
Top 200 models account for 49.6% of all downloads, indicating high ecosystem concentration
Llama is the most downloaded model family with 476 million cumulative downloads by March 2026
Supports fine-tuning workflows and AutoTrain for no-code training
Private model repositories and access controls for enterprise teams
platforms.best_for: Researchers, data scientists, and open-source developers who need to discover, share, version, and collaboratively develop ML models and datasets.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A local LLM runtime that allows users to download and run open-source large language models entirely on their own hardware with a simple CLI and API interface.
platforms.pricing: Completely free and open-source; costs are limited to local hardware and electricity.
features: One-command download and execution of models like Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Gemma
Runs fully offline with no data sent to external servers
Local REST API compatible with OpenAI's API schema for easy integration
Supports macOS, Linux, and Windows including GPU acceleration via CUDA and Metal
Model library with quantized variants for running large models on consumer hardware
Integrates with Open WebUI for a self-hosted ChatGPT-like interface
Supports multimodal models including vision-language models
Active community with broad support from tools like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Dify
platforms.best_for: Privacy-conscious developers, hobbyists, and enterprises needing fully offline, zero-cost local inference without any cloud dependency.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform that provides a simple pay-per-second API to run open-source machine learning models without managing any infrastructure.
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second billing based on hardware used; no upfront cost or subscription required. GPU instance rates start around $0.000225/second for CPU up to $0.0023/second for A100 GPUs.
features: Instant API access to 50,000+ open-source models including image, video, audio, and language models
No infrastructure setup required; models run on managed cloud GPUs
Supports custom model deployment via Cog, an open-source containerization tool
Automatic scaling including scale-to-zero to eliminate idle costs
Webhooks and asynchronous prediction support for production pipelines
Model versioning with immutable version hashes for reproducibility
Active model marketplace with community-contributed models
OpenAI-compatible endpoints for select language models
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups who need fast access to a wide variety of open-source models via API with minimal setup and a simple usage-based cost structure.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A cloud inference and fine-tuning platform specializing in low-cost, high-throughput serving of open-source LLMs with an OpenAI-compatible API.
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token pricing; among the lowest in the market for open-source LLMs. Example: Llama 3.1 8B at approximately $0.10 per million tokens. Fine-tuning billed per token processed plus storage.
features: OpenAI-compatible REST API enabling drop-in replacement for existing applications
Supports leading open-source models including Llama, Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek, and DBRX
Managed fine-tuning with LoRA and full fine-tuning options
Dedicated inference endpoints for latency-sensitive production workloads
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) support
High-throughput batch inference for large-scale offline processing
Together Research division contributing open-source models and efficiency research
Flash Attention and other inference optimizations for speed and cost efficiency
platforms.best_for: Cost-conscious developers and enterprises running high-volume LLM inference workloads who want OpenAI API compatibility with open-source models at lower cost.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference platform purpose-built for production-grade speed and low latency serving of open-source generative AI models.
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token pricing competitive with Together AI; offers serverless and dedicated deployment tiers. Serverless inference for Llama 3.1 8B starts around $0.10 per million tokens.
features: Industry-leading inference speed with proprietary FireAttention optimization engine
OpenAI-compatible API for seamless migration from existing stacks
Supports text, image, audio, and embedding models
Function calling and structured output (JSON mode) support
Fine-tuned model deployment with private model hosting
On-demand and reserved capacity options for predictable workloads
Real-time and batch inference modes
Low time-to-first-token optimizations suited for interactive applications
platforms.best_for: Developers and product teams building latency-sensitive applications such as real-time chat, coding assistants, and voice interfaces where inference speed is the top priority.

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.purpose: A fully managed enterprise cloud service from Amazon Web Services that provides access to a curated selection of foundation models from multiple providers via a unified API, with deep AWS ecosystem integration.
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token on-demand pricing; Provisioned Throughput available for committed capacity at discounted rates. Model prices vary by provider; e.g., Claude 3.5 Sonnet at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens.
features: Access to models from Anthropic (Claude), Meta (Llama), Mistral, Amazon (Titan, Nova), Stability AI, and others through a single API
Native integration with AWS services including S3, Lambda, SageMaker, and IAM
Bedrock Agents for building autonomous multi-step AI agents with tool use
Knowledge Bases for managed RAG pipelines connected to enterprise data sources
Model evaluation tools for comparing model performance and quality
Guardrails for content filtering, PII redaction, and responsible AI enforcement
Fine-tuning and continued pre-training support for select models
Private model deployment within customer VPC for data residency compliance
Enterprise-grade security with SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR compliance support
platforms.best_for: Enterprises already invested in the AWS ecosystem that need production-ready, compliant, and governable access to leading foundation models with minimal MLOps overhead.
